entities.name: γH2AX
observations: Phosphorylated H2AX at Ser139 accumulates around DNA double-strand breaks and serves as an early DNA-damage signaling marker.
γH2AX is a downstream readout of the ATM-centered double-strand-break response, not a marker of repair completion.

entities.name: γH2AX DSB marker
observations: γH2AX phosphorylation signifies DNA double-strand-break-associated damage signaling; among the listed choices, no option states this exactly.
ATM activation is upstream of H2AX phosphorylation, while double-strand-break resolution is not what γH2AX signifies.
